baseline.description: feat(phase7): breakout directional asymmetry research harness -- current production behavior, NO directional branch, frozen thresholds. Immutable baseline for 7E.

verdict.message: the synthetic DIRECTIONAL hypothesis does NOT reproduce on real OOS data: win-rate gap -4.7pp below the 5.0pp materiality floor (bull 79.2% vs bear 74.5%); expectancy bull +0.067R vs bear +0.059R. The bearish-strong / bullish-weak signal is absent -> discard the synthetic hypothesis (outcome B).
